Two links were created in your project connecting the 1875 census record for **"Anders Pedersen"** (assertion `a_001`) to **Anders Hansen** in the tree, but both were recorded at the lowest certainty level — **"speculative"** — because of a significant conflict that must be resolved before the link can be confirmed.

### What the record shows
- **Name in census:** Anders *Pedersen* (patronymic = son of Peder)
- **Birthplace/year:** Ringsaker, Hedmark, Norway — around 1868
- **Identity score:** 0.82 (strong match on location and birth year)

### Why the link is only speculative
